Iris (Design): Quick sync: two small but annoying UX nits spotted in Console on compact density. 1) icon-only buttons in table rows feel tiny — hit target < 32px. 2) toast shows for 700ms then disappears; users miss it when they scan rows quickly. Screenshot + short video in thread.
Connor (Frontend): Repro: open datasets table -> enable compact density -> hover row -> action icons appear; on small screens the padding collapses so icons are ~20x20 visually and clickable area is tight. Also after bulk edit, toast appears bottom-left for 700ms, then vanishes.
Yara (a11y): Icon-only controls must keep 44px hit area minimum. Two approaches: 1) keep visual size but increase invisible padding using ::before padding box, or 2) drop compact mode to keep 8px min padding. Either way, add descriptive accessible names (aria-label) for each icon button. Example: `<button aria-label="Delete row" class="icon-btn">...</button>`
Derek (Product): We want compact mode for power users but not at the expense of accessibility. Proposal: allow compact density but with a min-hit token (min-hit=44). Also increase default toast duration to 2s for non-critical success messages; keep 5s for errors.
Iris (Design): UX preference: keep visuals tight but add a subtle 8px invisible hit padding and no extra visual whitespace. For tooltips, keep 250ms delay on hover but add focus-visible tooltip on keyboard focus immediately.
Connor (Frontend): Implementation notes: spacing tokens currently have token.compact.iconPadding = 6px. I'll change to token.compact.iconPadding = 6px + token.minHitPadding = 8px applied as hitbox via padding but with negative margin to avoid layout shift. Snippet: `button.icon-btn{ padding:6px; } button.icon-btn::before{ content:''; position:absolute; inset:-8px; }` Will add aria-label enforcement in ESLint rule for icon buttons.
Yara (a11y): Also ensure that when table rows collapse into a stacked mobile view the action icons become full-width buttons with visible labels — icon-only on small widths is bad. Add a breakpoint rule: `@media(max-width:640px) .row-actions => display:block; .icon-btn => width:100%;`
Derek (Product): Toast timing: +1 on longer duration for success toasts. But let's make it configurable by teams. Default success 2000ms, info 2500ms, error 5000ms. Also add an option to pin toast if user hovers or focuses it.
Connor (Frontend): I'll open a small PR: 1) add token `minHitSize=44` and apply to icon buttons in table, 2) enforce aria-label lint, 3) change toast default durations and add hover-pause/pin. Will add a Cypress e2e that checks hitbox using boundingClientRect.
Yara (a11y): Tiny extra: prefer `aria-describedby` on toast linking to related row when toast references a specific item (eg. "Saved dataset: X" -> modal or row gets `aria-describedby=toast-<ts>`). For errors we should move focus to the error summary.
Iris (Design): Thanks. I'll update the token docs and add a quick Figma frame showing invisible hit padding. Posting in #design-assets shortly.
release-bot: New PR opened by connor: frontend#2533 — "table: min-hit token + icon aria-label lint + toast timing"
Connor (Frontend): Tagging @Yara for review on a11y changes and @Iris for design verification. ETA for review: tomorrow morning. :rocket:
